run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit completed. Exactly four namespaces in the cluster matched the prefix 'app-283' (app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search), and each contained a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest'. All four ConfigMaps expose an 'audit_code' key (alongside 'owner' and 'tier'), with values TDW283-BLX94Q (billing), TDW283-QGF48V (ledger), TDW283-MDP61Z (media) and TDW283-SRK27M (search). The namespace listing was not truncated and all four per-namespace ConfigMap queries returned exactly one object each, so no matching namespace is missing a reported code. These are point-in-time reads of live cluster objects (observed ~2026-11-21T09:09:44Z); they do not establish what the values were at any earlier time in the authorized window.
